patterns.name: edge-service
patterns.description: Public HTTP workload with explicit edge ownership and runtime verification.

patterns.name: internal-async-service
patterns.description: Long-running internal service that owns async-eventing ingress or relay behavior through the Dapr application boundary.

patterns.name: operator-job
patterns.description: Manual or CI-triggered one-off task with explicit idempotency and bounded runtime semantics.

patterns.name: scheduled-job
patterns.description: Recurring task launched by a scheduler and validated through runtime conformance and delivery evidence.

patterns.name: export-job
patterns.description: Scheduled export job that emits platform-visible success evidence and writes dataset artifacts to a runtime-owned sink.
